description: Concentrates exclusively on defending for one turn.  Increases tactical points.  Reduces damage taken while it has effect.
name: Guard
note:
<dgnPriority:3>
<dgnInfo:
Concentrates exclusively on defending for
one turn.  Increases tactical points.
Reduces damage taken while it has effect.
>
<dgnInfo2:
    Guarding is a special combat skill
available to all player characters in the
adventuring party.  When guarding, a
character's defense's are bolstered and
the damage they suffer if they are hit in
combat is reduced to half as much by
default, further modified by equipment
and gear as well as their natural ability
to avoid getting hurt and defend
themselves in combat.  Spells, items, and
certain equipment can change one's guard
effect.
>

<dgnMessageCasts>
<dgnSpell><dgnRanged>
<dgnEquipType:book>
<dgnArmorType:wizard's book>
<dgnInfo:
(Wizardry) This spell induces magical
rage in one enemy, if successful.
Enemies in combat that are magically
enraged will attack their enemies
endlessly without controlling themselves.
Player-controlled characters that are
affected will blindly attack
automatically, without having any normal
options for that character to choose what
to do in a combat turn.  Being struck
with an attack that does damage can make
an affected character "snap out of it"
and break the spell early, otherwise it
will eventually wear off.
>

Free attack, doesn't cost anything.

description:
(Martial Arts) Performes a special knife-hand attack that weakens an enemy's attack, agility, and luck for a 5 turns.
Uses Spirit Focus Magic (MP) and Tactical Points (TP).
name: Deep Knife-Hand Attack

description:
(Martial Arts) Punches a single target with single, powerful attack that does a lot of damage.  Targets hit by this punch also lose some luck for five turns.
Uses Spirit Focus Magic (MP) and Tactical Points (TP).
name: Killer Punch

description:

Uses Spirit Focus Magic (MP) and Tactical Points (TP).
name: Windstorm Fist Attack

description: (Martial Arts) Punches a single target with fast left-right punches, one from each fist.  Punches channel the magic of the attacker's spirit, making the attack use and deploy elemental fire.
name: 2x Flaming Punch

description:
(Martial Arts) Performs a basic, single front kick at one target.  Strikes only once.
Costs nothing to perform.  Raises Tactical Points a little, as usual.
name: Basic Front Kick

description:
(Martial Arts) Performs a hard-hitting and high-speed side kick.  Does more damage than a plain kick attack does.
Uses Spirit Focus Magic (MP).  Doesn't require any Tactical Points.
name: Hard Side Kick

description:
(Martial Arts) Performs a super-fast flying kick that is enhanced with Spirit Focus Magic.  Although not the most damaging attack, it is VERY quick.
Uses Spirit Focus Magic (MP) and Tactical Points (TP).  Has a chance to stun the target for a few short turns.
name: Flying Thunderfast Kick

description:
(Martial Arts) Performs a hard and lightning-fast roundhouse kick that can easily break bones in creatures that have them.  Temporarily weaken's a target's attack score.
Uses Spirit Focus Magic (MP) and Tactical Points (TP).
name: Breaking Spin Kick

description:
(Martial Arts) Quickly performs a rapid flurry of very hard-hitting kicks at up to four random enemies.  Expensive, but damaging.
Uses up Spirit Focus Magic (MP) and Tactical Points (TP).
name: Storm Kicks

description:
(Martial Arts) Performs a storm of strikes from the hands and feet that attempt to hit every single target twice.
Uses Spirit Focus Magic (MP) and Tactical Points (TP).
name: Thunderstorm Hand and Foot

description:
(Martial Arts) Performs a storm of strikes from the hands and feet that attempt to hit every single target four times.
Uses Spirit Focus Magic (MP) and Tactical Points (TP).
name: Hurricane Hand and Foot

description:
(Martial Arts) Performs a storm of strikes from the hands and feet that attempt to hit every single target seven times.
Uses Spirit Focus Magic (MP) and Tactical Points (TP).
name: Spirit Vortex Hand and Foot

description:
(Martial Arts)  Focuses one's spirit magic and lets it loose to blast all targets.
Damages enemies' MP (Magic Points), and weakens their defense, luck, magical attack, and magical defense scores, for a number of turns.
name: Spirit Focus Blast

description:
(Martial Arts)  Takes a moment to focus one's spirit magic, to align and direct it, and effectively turn Magic Points into Tactical Points.
Each use creates up to 50 Tactical Points.
name: Align Spirit Magic

Finger Claws
note:
<dgnPriority:1.0001>
<dgnMessageAttacksWith>
<dgnInnate>
<dgnCostByLevelMp>
<dgnInfo:
(Innate) This attack is available to
people of a race who have retractable
claws that can grow and degenerate in and
out of the end of the fingertips of one's
hands, independent of and below the
fingernails.  Certain species of dragon
people have such claws, as well as orcs,
and others, though not always humans.
Finger claws are a good alternative
emergency backup weapon in combat, and
are somewhat better than a simple punch
of the fist.  Some people who have
finger claws can spend magic points for
finger claw attacks that do elemental
damage, or have special effects.
>

<dgnMessageAttacksWith>
<dgnInnate>
<dgnCostByLevelMp>
<dgnInfo:
(Innate) This attack is available to
people of a race who have retractable
claws that can grow and degenerate in and
out of the end of the fingertips of one's
hands, independent of and below the
fingernails.  Certain species of dragon
people have such claws, as well as orcs,
and others, though not always humans.
Finger claws are a good alternative
emergency backup weapon in combat, and
are somewhat better than a simple punch
of the fist.  Some people who have
finger claws can spend magic points for
finger claw attacks that do elemental
damage, or have special effects.
>

name: Firebreathing Finishing Move, Fire
note:
<dgnPriority:1.8101>
<dgnMessageAttacksWith>
<dgnRanged>
<dgnInnate>
<dgnInfo:
Innate to people who are full-blooded
dragon boys,
but not half dragon boys,
this lethal, wide-spread attack unleashes
a wide cone of
fire
from the mouth of the attacker upon
all targets.
This is a very special "finishing move"
that can end and win a battle in one
powerful attack, or at least turn the
tide a bit, and using it involves the
dragon boy pulling his head off of his
neck and holding it up and in front of
himself, typically his hand holding his
head by it's hair, as the cone erupts
from his mouth and his head magically
deflates like a rubber balloon.  After
his head is deflated, it is spent, empty,
deflated skin and hair that is tossed
aside, discarded as no longer usable,
and leaves the dragon boy headless and
magically still alive and able to see and
hear.  He can then later spend magic
points to use an innate ability to
grow a new head.  Until he does so, he
suffers minor ability penalties in combat
for being headless, and equipped headgear
and jewelry such as face piercings and
ear cuffs are temporarily unusable.
>

name: Dragon Roar
note:
<dgnPriority:1.0501>
<dgnMessageCasts>
<dgnRanged>
<dgnMiscellaneous>
<dgnCostByLevelMp>
<dgnCostByLevelTp>
<dgnInfo:
An innate ability of dragon boys and
half dragon boys, this ability uses
specialized vocal cords other than the
normal ones used for speaking, etc., and
generates a very LOUD and intimidating
yell that has magically enhanced sound
characteristics, including high-volume
tones at various mid to low frequencies,
with especially loud low-end bass tones
that make walls, trees, and the dirt and
rock things are built upon quake.  It is
intended to scare the heck out of living
creatures and monsters of nearly all
kinds, inducing whatever panic or startle
response enemies are capable of.  When it
works properly, enemies on the
battlefield are scared half to death.
This can give one's self and allies a few
short moments to quickly strike first
while enemies are scared stiff.
>

description:
(Magic Spell) This spell temporarily makes one ally quicker, allowing the affected ally to make additional actions in combat whenever it is their turn.
This spell can be cast inside and outside of combat, and outside of combat it lasts for a short while.
name: Haste

description: (Magic Spell)
name: Sleep
note:
<dgnPriority:5>
<dgnShowItemLevelInSkillCost>
<dgnMessageCasts>
<dgnSpell><dgnRanged>
<dgnEquipType:book>
<dgnArmorType:wizard's book>
<dgnInfo:
(Magic Spell) This spell induces magical
sleep in one enemy, if successful.
Enemies in combat that are made to sleep
cannot act or defend themselves, and
typically wake up after a few turns, or
if they are hit by some type of attack
that does any damage.
>

description: (Magic Spell)
name: Rage
note:
<dgnPriority:5>
<dgnShowItemLevelInSkillCost>
<dgnMessageCasts>
<dgnSpell><dgnRanged>
<dgnEquipType:book>
<dgnArmorType:wizard's book>
<dgnInfo:
(Magic Spell) This spell induces magical
rage in one enemy, if successful.
Enemies in combat that are magically
enraged will attack their enemies
endlessly without controlling themselves.
Player-controlled characters that are
affected will blindly attack
automatically, without having any normal
options for that character to choose what
to do in a combat turn.  Being struck
with an attack that does damage can make
an affected character "snap out of it"
and break the spell early, otherwise it
will eventually wear off.
>
